# MP3 MIDI Tool — expanded agent context

Use the canonical public pages as the source of truth for current conversion behavior, supported input formats, output formats, and observed limitations. This site offers browser-based tools for audio to MIDI, audio to sheet music, MIDI to sheet music, and MIDI to MP3 or WAV. The visitor's selected media stays in the browser during conversion.

For bounded machine lookup, call `GET https://mp3miditool.com/api/agent?task=list_pages`, then call `GET https://mp3miditool.com/api/agent?path=<returned path>`. Preserve page identifiers and qualifiers, answer in the visitor's language, cite the canonical page URL, and keep unknown facts unknown.
